meshy_tasks.prompt: Galewisp, the air starter fox-bird creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, repainted to match the board reference sheet. FUR AND DOWN: warm cream (#EDE3CC) everywhere the fur is pale, never stark white; soft warm cream face, chest and belly. CHEST RUFF: a big round fluffy cream chest ruff with layered soft feather-fur scallops, framed by the steel-blue feather V-pattern on the shoulders and down the centre of the chest exactly where the 3D model has it. EARS: two MATCHING tall fox ear tufts, identical to each other, layered feathers shading from steel blue (#4f86b0) at the tips through soft blue-grey to warm cream at the base. FACE: EXACTLY the same face as the 3D model render: huge round WIDE-OPEN blue eyes, fully open, no eyelids drooping, no sleepy look, large white catchlights; a warm golden-ochre eye mask (#d7a64a) around both eyes; small dark nose; happy curious expression. WINGS: forelimb wings with layered feathers, steel-blue primaries (#4f86b0) and pale blue-grey secondaries (#9fbccb), cream inner membrane, and a row of golden-ochre covert feathers (#d7a64a) along the top edge of each wing. TAIL: a full fanned tail of layered feathers in clear bands of saturated steel blue (#4f86b0) and warm cream, with cream tips, matching the board. Dark grey bird legs and claws. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no scenery, no text. No red, pink, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.
